answer: Work waits on the mesa until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the dawn of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vault of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, published publicly on failure, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
